title: NVIDIA surfaced Nemotron VoiceChat 11B code and model resources
summary: On 2026-08-04, the record linked NVIDIA's Nemotron VoiceChat development branch in NVIDIA-NeMo/Speech and the NVIDIA-NemotronLabs-VoiceChat-11B model repository on Hugging Face. Together, those dated links indicate a material public-availability milestone for the project's code and model artifacts. The exact release claims, capabilities, and licensing were not researched for this review.
